comments.body: in our lab at ETH we give our best to correct the exams right after it finished. Such that we can do more than 200 corrections of hand-written exams (up to 10 pages) in less than 1 week. There is no excuse to not do it because you know there will be this exam so plan early on the week of correction. Student put a lot of effort into it, so do we.
comments.author: spacedario
